scope: Eligibility and custody rules for the trusted custodian evaluator. Decision numbers (retention floors, margins, citation floor) remain the frozen v1.6 decision contract; this policy governs which evaluations may yield a verdict at all.
forbidden: Accepting caller-supplied aggregate metrics as authoritative.
Deriving scope from a command-line flag alone.
Treating a submitter-generated manifest as independent attestation.
Using public tasks or draft labels for a final verdict.
Tuning any value to observed semantic-model results.

citation_policy.note: Values mirror the frozen v1.6 decision contract. The custodian re-derives them from per-case records; it never trusts a caller-supplied pass rate.

uncertainty_policy.rule: Verdict requires the retention interval lower bound at/above floor, the misleading interval upper bound at/below cap, and paired-difference intervals clear of both margins. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
